actual_package_test.commit_scope_dialog_retest: Isolated the Find/Replace assertions from pre-existing edits and verified the scoped script against the installed seven files, including temporary resource cleanup.

current_desktop_core_matrix.additional_assertions: Both deliberate painter leak checks and both standalone CoreWindow rejection checks passed.
current_desktop_core_matrix.scope: Selected self-owned window and theme fixtures plus ABI. Review excluded desktop or physical-input paths, global and propagation scenarios, and unrelated groups. This is not a full run of all registered tests.

real_winui_paint.native_baseline: XAML bridge present, no ntwshk, native non-client DWM rendering enabled
real_winui_paint.themes: Win16 and Win2K loaded the installed DLL, preserved the XAML bridge and disabled native DWM non-client rendering
real_winui_paint.caption_commands: Both themed instances passed maximize, minimize and two restores, then exited normally
real_winui_paint.live_removal: Both themes restored native DWM rendering, outer, client and visible frame rectangles, and preserved the same XAML bridge in a fresh process at 96 DPI.

real_modern_hosts_previous_snapshot.Calculator from O:/winnt: Both theme launches timed out (1460) with distinct ApplicationFrameWindow absent.
real_modern_hosts_previous_snapshot.Scan using the same published DLL and th: Both theme launches timed out (1460) with distinct ApplicationFrameWindow absent.
real_modern_hosts_previous_snapshot.session: Foreground window was present before testing. The host-assignment timeout cause is unconfirmed.
real_modern_hosts_previous_snapshot.native_activation_control: Direct IApplicationActivationManager without run16s launched both applications in the same session. Each visible CoreWindow remained its own root for 12 s. The two owned instances exited. An ApplicationFrameWindow is absent before styling.

current_native_uwp_topology.result: Native activation succeeded. Both CoreWindow handles were their own root and root owner with DWM_CLOAKED_SHELL set. Three ApplicationFrameWindow roots existed on the desktop; none contained either fresh instance.
current_native_uwp_topology.shell_start_comparison: A separate shell:AppsFolder activation produced zero eligible outer frames in eight observations. The first Calculator sample preceded CoreWindow creation. All seven CoreWindow observations were standalone and DWM_CLOAKED_SHELL.
current_native_uwp_topology.cleanup: Both freshly created instances were ended after the bounded graceful close did not exit.

modern_host_failure_contracts.scope: Owned or simulated windows. Host start and failure cleanup, window and UWP callback reentrancy, dialog unwind, and simulated UWP apply/remove retries.

calculator.Win2K: functional checks passed; screen pixel sampling unavailable

scan.Win2K: functional checks passed; screen pixel sampling unavailable

rdp_live_uwp_on_p1.functional_checks: Each pair attached to a real hosted window, preserved window commands and the outer window rectangle, and removed the frame surface.
rdp_live_uwp_on_p1.first_calculator_win16_attempt: The installed launcher returned 1460. The probe subsequently observed a separate root without a styled surface. A bounded retry passed all functional checks.

rdp_live_calculator_win2k_on_p8.functional_checks: Installed standard command exited 0. The owned native Calculator attached and passed maximize, restore, minimize, live removal and exact outer-rectangle restoration.
rdp_live_calculator_win2k_on_p8.pixel_sampling: Both points hit the live overlay. Desktop DC and overlay window DC returned CLR_INVALID. PrintWindow returned FALSE. Real composited pixel verification remains skipped.
rdp_live_calculator_win2k_on_p8.cleanup: Calculator and probe exited. All five probe scratch files were removed.

installed_control_theme_matrix.scope: A disjoint supplement to the previous 43 package cases. Verified seven installed hashes before and after, using the installed launcher and owned dual-width fixtures for the existing theme assertions.
per_architecture: Win2K static startup v5 and v6

installed_caption_command_matrix.scope: Eight Win2K caption and window command cases plus five Win16 and Win2K system menu cases per architecture. Installed seven-file hashes verified before and after. Owned windows, native messages, no physical input.

installed_dialog_api_matrix.scope: Installed Win2K Win32 dialog contracts and Win16 COM event, navigation, redirect and veto contracts. Owned windows with dialog-test-driver --direct. Printed no jobs. Verified all seven hashes before and after.

rdp_actual_uwp_surface_pixels.result: Exact match to the Win2K theme interpolation on both real UWP style surfaces. Maximize, minimize, restore and live removal with geometry preservation passed. Desktop composition and WinUI screen pixels remain unverified.

unverified: real Win2K UWP and WinUI screen pixels

layout_retirement_delivery.first_run_failure: Original fixture placed its right edge beyond the narrow RDP working area; old and new both reproduced it. Updated fixture fits the window to the working area and keeps the original pixel assertions.

actual_package_test.prior_evidence_scope: Earlier observations apply to their tested binaries. P38 results are in client_menu_delivery.

per_architecture: composed caption lifecycle and hit test
paint_composition_delivery.real_paint: Installed Win2K on Microsoft Paint 11.2609.441.0 at 96 DPI, sampled three actual desktop pixels per state on the owned window. Caption and close hit tests passed in each sampled state. Minimize and restore passed and the owned instance exited.
paint_composition_delivery.initial_capture: Concurrent first attempt returned CLR_INVALID for all three points. Sequential retry passed.

not_retested: physical hover pixels for a modified theme

shared_tab_delivery.scope: Same P24 runtime renders literal ampersands or mnemonic text using one changed external tab-label record. Stock tab, header and trackbar hashes match P23 on both widths. Previous theme files remain usable.

shared_header_text_delivery.scope: Both header providers use standard Header.HeaderItem(Normal/Pressed).TextColor. Owned v6 controls yielded both explicit colors and preserved their native click notifications. Stock tab, header and trackbar hashes match P24.

menu_font_delivery.scope: Both stock and former themes produced P25 menu pixel hashes on both widths. Two altered themes per adapter use the same declared Arial description and vary only CLASSIC_STYLE realization. Actual system-menu label pixels changed on both widths. Logical 480-DPI realization verified.

push_text_delivery.scope: Standard Button.PushButton state TextColor values reached actual GDI glyph pixels with both adapters. Stock push button and group box image hashes match P27.

caption_corners_delivery.scope: Both modern geometry adapters use the ordinary caption button width from Window.MinButton.Width. Mixed 23- and 25-DIP test layouts checked the two pixels straddling the resize corner. Native owned fixtures verify both installed runtime providers.

updown_delivery.scope: Both adapters use the shared UpDown recolor and native fallback. Both widths verified that changing only CLASSIC_STYLE record 28 from indexed art to recolor on the full-client adapter changes actual horizontal and vertical pixels and preserves the native position.
updown_delivery.remaining: The observed/nonclient regular startup does not supply native draw callbacks required for indexed UpDown art.
updown_delivery.environment_diagnostic: The first run inherited a console, producing two Terminal attachment diagnostics (1306). Running the same tests with CREATE_NO_WINDOW yielded all ten passes without this diagnostic. Terminal behavior is outside the UpDown result.

indexed_updown_delivery.scope: Standard Win32 startup with the indexed UpDown theme. Theme fixtures differ in one window-provider byte; both providers preserve native notifications, native position and detach. Startup reuses the existing GDI callbacks inside styled processes.

native_roles_delivery.scope: Seven owned Win32 controls per provider, width and theme mode. Both stock profiles attach; otherwise identical external themes with presentation records omitted leave the controls native. Shared pure policy and real class identification checked independently.

common_link_delivery.scope: Neutral full-client layout and native window palette are one object apiece in style-window; the former common archive is absent from both formal link commands. The old PE name resolves and returns the same eight host colors in each width.

raster_font_delivery.scope: Dual-architecture registered face identity, native font borrowing and last release, both themed menu creation modes, installed system menu pixel hashes, and installed edit paint/removal.
raster_font_delivery.scope_limit: Owned Win32 fixtures. No physical input or full package matrix. The separately rebuilt standalone compatibility target does not participate in either formal runtime link.

progress_control_delivery.scope: Two attachment paths share the reentrancy-checked native snapshot and drawing, retaining native class and edge eligibility. Owned fixtures test both themes and Common Controls generations.

header_trackbar_delivery.scope: Trackbar custom draw and header item framing/text share theme-driven presentation. Client and native header each keep their window lifecycle. VCL app callbacks, nested drawing, clipping, removal and GDI counts tested.

native_dialog_delivery.scope: Caller-provided dialog geometry and refcounted print resources; both themed stock and mixed policy paths; actual General Cancel and Apply with both widths.

client_menu_delivery.scope: Neutral client-area menu measurement, menu bar and MDI, owned popup rows, and nested popup scope. Both adapters share ink and mark rendering. Preserves compatibility exports and observed/native menu geometry.

native_menu_window_delivery.scope: Actual launches from both installed paths. Two themes, native system menu text and cancellation, Win32 runtime caption creation, natural resizing and style restoration. Both widths also tested the same-build standalone compatibility DLL and all six self-owned style transitions.

build.command: tools/Build-Package.ps1 worker on isolated HEAD plus scoped P39 inputs, shared build/.ccache
